title: wslua: fix TreeItem:children duplicate nodes
description:
Remove extraneous code that caused `TreeItem:children()` to store nodes
it had already processed for future processing.

Rename some variables in the `TreeItem_iterator_state` struct for
clarity: `current_node` to `next_node`, and `stack` to `children`.

Fixes #21085
AI-Assisted: no

Closes #21085
